title: Files
purpose: Family and guest folders, per-person logins and the Andrew-only brain share, shared over the home network with Samba.
description: Read-only view of the file shares: running state and version, each share with its folder and who may read or write, the names that have logins (never passwords), who is connected now, free space and the file sharing port.

Lists each share, its folder and who has read-only or read-write access
Lists the names that have logins, never passwords or hashes
Shows who is connected now, from where and since when
Shows free space on the data volume
access: Home Assistant authenticated ingress only; read-only
